title: PERSONALITY ALIGNMENT OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the personality alignment performance (Aligned Score) of the models across different age groups (ranging from 10 to 70 years) using the PAPI dataset to identify any performance degradation or disparities in older demographics.

Evaluating and comparing the personality alignment performance between male and female subjects to identify gender-specific patterns and disparities in alignment difficulty across the Big Five personality dimensions.

Assessing personality alignment scores across subjects from various countries (including Western, European, and Asian nations) to observe cross-cultural variations and test the models' ability to capture culture-specific personality traits.
